album.title: Radif of Persian Music on Setar II

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Eb4 and dwells most on Eb in Maghlub. Forud (0:16.7) introduces Ck, Db, F, centred on Eb. The line peaks at Gk4 (386.4 Hz) at 0:09.0. It closes on Db4, not the tonic (Eb4 → Dk4 → Gk3 → Ck4 → Ck4 → Db4).

theory_fit.name: Farhat interval classes

flags: tonic Gk set in the catalog (Segah's finalis G koron (193.5 Hz): six of the suite's nine tracks voted it and the pitch set fits from it (0, 142, 355, 497, 700, 852, 1065 cents). The vote picked the 4th above; Maghlub follows Mokhalef in a mode of its own centred on the 6th (Farhat 1990, pp. 54-55). Inference, not yet by ear); the runs' vote favoured 256.1 Hz (Cs)
